title: UiSurface
description: ui.surface@1: the catalog a product publishes for one surface people may arrange (bot.controls, bot.overlay, live.channel, dock, chat.composer, navbar.shortcuts). It names the surface, its device classes and grid, the theme tokens its styles draw from, and every part a layout may place. A part says what it is (stick, button, slider, readout, video, list), whether it is required or pressed, its minimum cells and the minimum pixels the product guarantees (44 px for anything pressed, larger for Stop), the sizes and styles it allows, the bindings it accepts, and the parts it must never cover. A layout is validated against this catalog (openvibe-sdk/ui-layout); a layout can arrange only what the catalog has and can never add a power. The catalog is data: a layout or an AI answer never carries code or a URL.

version.description: The catalog version. A layout names the version it was made against.

name.description: What the surface is called where a person sees it.

devices.description: The device classes this surface offers.

columns.description: The grid's columns per device class: 4 on a phone and 12 on a computer in the design; a product may choose otherwise within these bounds.

cell_px.description: The smallest a cell is rendered at that device class, in CSS pixels, at the narrowest supported width. The validator multiplies a part's cells by this to check the 44 px rule.

theme_tokens.description: The theme tokens a tint may name (accent, surface, danger, ...). Never a colour value: the theme decides what the token is.

id.description: Stable part id inside this catalog, e.g. stop, stick, battery.

required.description: A required part is always visible and at its minimum size. A layout that hides or shrinks it is refused. Stop is not required: it is an ordinary part a person may add.

pressed.description: The part sends a command when pressed or moved; it must render at least 44 px on every side.

min.description: The smallest size a layout may give the part: w and h in grid cells, and px when the product guarantees more than 44 px (Stop).

sizes.description: Sizes the editor may offer as presets. A layout is not limited to these: it is limited to min and to the grid.

tints.description: The theme tokens this part may be tinted with; every one is also in the surface's theme_tokens.

opacity.description: The opacity range this part allows; the design's range is 0.4 to 1.

label.description: Whether the editor may show the part's label on it.

bindings.description: The bindings the product accepts for this part. A layout may pick a subset, never add one.

never_covers.description: The parts this part must never cover, in addition to the surface-wide rule that nothing covers a required part.
